action.description: create_env creates a user-scoped Conda env. pip_install installs packages into an existing user env. ensure_packages creates the env if missing, installs requested packages, and probes imports. probe checks imports without changing the env.

envName.description: User environment name. The resolved prefix is always <userEnvRoot>/<envName>; absolute paths and ../ are rejected.

pythonVersion.description: Python version for create_env or ensure_packages when the env does not exist.

packages.description: PyPI package specifiers to install, such as doped or doped==3.1.0. URLs, local paths, whitespace, and leading dash options are rejected.

imports.description: Import names to probe after create/install, such as doped.

dryRun.description: Return the planned command and validated prefix without executing conda or pip.
